## Adding Packages

```{r}
set.seed(1234) 
pacman::p_load(sf, tidyverse, MCI, tmap, ggstatsplot)
```

## Importing Data

### Importing Geospatial Data

```{r}
stores <- st_read(
  dsn = "data/geospatial",
  layer = "STORES_TC")
```

```{r}
town <- st_read(
  dsn = "data/geospatial",
  layer = "TOWN_TC")
```

```{r}
village <- st_read(
  dsn = "data/geospatial",
  layer = "VILLAGE_TC")
```

```{r}
tmap_mode("view")
tm_shape(town) +
  tm_polygons() +
  tm_shape(village) +
  tm_polygons() +
  tm_shape(stores) +
  tm_dots()
```

### Importing Aspatial Data

```{r}
pop2019 <- read_csv(
  "data/aspatial/pop2019.csv")
```

```{r}
store_sales <- read_csv(
  "data/aspatial/Store_sales_data.csv")
```

## Data Preparation

### Aggregating Store Sales

```{r}
store_sales_aggre <- store_sales %>%
  group_by(`Store Code`) %>%
  summarise(
    "Total_Bill" = sum(Bills, na.rm = TRUE),
    "Total_Sales" = sum(Amount, na.rm = TRUE))
```

### Relational Join

```{r}
stores <- stores %>%
  left_join(store_sales_aggre,
            by = join_by(
              Store_CD == `Store Code`)) %>%
  mutate(Store_size = 100)
```

```{r}
summary(stores)
```

### **Tidying the pop2019 Data Frame**

```{r}
glimpse(pop2019)
```

```{r}
glimpse(village)
```

```{r}
pop2019 <- pop2019 %>%
  mutate(V_ID = str_remove_all(
    V_ID, "-"))
```

```{r}
village <- village %>%
  left_join(pop2019,
            by = join_by(
              VILLCODE == V_ID))
```

### **Checking for Missing or Zero Values**

```{r}
summary(village)
```

```{r}
village <- village %>%
  filter(!is.na(P_CNT))
```

```{r}
any(is.na(village$H_CNT))
```

```{r}
any(is.na(village$P_CNT))
```

```{r}
any(is.na(village$M_CNT))
```

```{r}
any(is.na(village$F_CNT))
```

## **Computing the Distance Matrix**

```{r}
village_center <- st_point_on_surface(village)
distmat <- st_distance(village_center, stores)
```

```{r}
rownames(distmat) <- village$`VILLCODE`
colnames(distmat) <- stores$`Store_CD`

distmat_long <- distmat %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "VILLCODE") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -VILLCODE,
    names_to = "Store_CD",
    values_to = "distance"
  ) %>%
  mutate(distance = as.numeric(distance))
```

## **Preparing the Interaction Matrix**

```{r}
interaction_matrix <- distmat_long %>%
  left_join(
    stores %>%
      st_drop_geometry() %>%
      select(Store_CD, Store_size),
    by = "Store_CD") %>%
  relocate(
    distance, .after = last_col())
```

```{r}
summary(interaction_matrix)
```

## **Computing the Huff Model**

```{r}
huff_share <- huff.shares(
  interaction_matrix, "VILLCODE", "Store_CD",
  "Store_size", "distance")
```

### **Trade Area Analysis for a Single Store**

```{r}
market_share <- huff_share %>%
  filter(Store_CD == "BT")
```

```{r}
Trade_area <- village %>%
  left_join(market_share)
```

```{r}
selected_store <- stores %>%
  filter(Store_CD == "BT")
```

```{r}
tm_shape(Trade_area) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "p_ij",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile",
                n = 10,
                values = "brewer.blues"),
              fill.legend = tm_legend(
                title = "Patronage Probability")) +
  tm_shape(selected_store) +
  tm_dots(size = 0.3,
          fill = "red",
          col = "black") +
  tm_title("Distribution of Patronage Probability of Store BT by village") +
  tm_layout(frame = TRUE) +
  tm_borders(fill_alpha = 0.5) +
  tm_compass(type="8star", size = 2) +
  tm_scalebar() +
  tm_grid(alpha =0.2)
```

### **Store Sales Analysis**

```{r}
huff_share_pp <- huff_share %>%
  left_join(village %>%
              st_drop_geometry() %>%
              select(VILLCODE, P_CNT),
            by = "VILLCODE") %>%
  relocate(
    distance, .after = last_col())
```

```{r}
huff_total <- shares.total(
  huff_share_pp, "VILLCODE", "Store_CD",
  "p_ij", "P_CNT")
```

```{r}
store_sales_est <- stores %>%
  left_join(huff_total,
            by = join_by(
              "Store_CD" == "suppliers_single"))
```

```{r}
store_sales_nongeom <- store_sales_est %>%
  st_drop_geometry()

ggscatterstats(
  store_sales_nongeom,
  x = sum_E_j,
  y = Total_Sales)
```

### **Reshaping the Market Shares**

```{r}
huff_share_wider <- huff_share %>%
  select(VILLCODE, Store_CD, p_ij) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Store_CD,
              values_from = p_ij)
```

```{r}
huff_TA <- huff_share_wider %>%
  mutate(
    TA = names(pick(2:29))[
      max.col(pick(2:29),
              ties.method = "first")
    ]
  )
```

```{r}
huff_TA_tidified <- huff_TA %>%
  select(VILLCODE, TA)

village_TA <- village %>%
  left_join(huff_TA_tidified,
            by = join_by(VILLCODE))
```

```{r}
tm_shape(village_TA) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "TA",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_categorical(values = "poly.glasbey"),
              fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "Trade area (store)"),
              col = "white",
              lwd = 0.2) +
  tm_shape(stores) +
  tm_dots(size = 0.4, fill = "black") +
  tm_text("Store_CD", size = 0.6, ymod = 0.7) +
  tm_title("Trade areas: the most likely store for each village")
```
